title: Payment service timeout during checkout
sample_log: timeout calling payment-provider after 30000ms request_id=req-8f21
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion in payment-service caused requests to wait until timeout.
remediation: Add alert for pool utilization above 80%

title: Checkout service returning 5xx errors
sample_log: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error connecting to redis-cache:6379
root_cause: Redis cache became unavailable, causing checkout session lookups to fail.
remediation: Add fallback handling for cache lookup failures

title: Authentication failures after certificate rotation
sample_log: JWT signature validation failed: kid not found in trusted key set
root_cause: New JWT signing certificate was deployed before all services refreshed their trusted key cache.
remediation: Refresh key cache on all auth consumers

title: Cart service pods repeatedly OOMKilled
sample_log: container cart-service terminated with reason OOMKilled exit_code=137
root_cause: Memory leak introduced in cart item aggregation logic caused pods to exceed memory limits.
remediation: Fix aggregation loop and add memory regression test

title: Order processing queue backlog
sample_log: consumer lag exceeded threshold topic=orders lag=185000
root_cause: Order worker consumer crashed after receiving malformed payloads and stopped processing messages.
remediation: Move malformed messages to dead-letter queue

title: Search latency spike
sample_log: search query timeout index=products duration_ms=8500
root_cause: Large Elasticsearch index merge consumed CPU and degraded query performance.
remediation: Move bulk indexing jobs outside peak traffic hours

title: Inventory count mismatch
sample_log: inventory cache value older than source timestamp sku=SKU-2911
root_cause: Cache invalidation job failed after deployment, leaving stale inventory values in Redis.
remediation: Add alert for cache age threshold

title: Notification emails delayed
sample_log: smtp provider rejected request: rate limit exceeded
root_cause: Email provider rate limit was exceeded during promotional traffic spike.

title: API gateway returning excessive 429 responses
sample_log: rate limit exceeded client_id=mobile-app limit=100/min
root_cause: Incorrect rate-limit configuration applied a global limit instead of per-user limit.

title: Profile service failing after deployment
sample_log: Missing required environment variable PROFILE_IMAGE_BUCKET
root_cause: Required environment variable was missing from the new deployment manifest.
remediation: Add deployment precheck for required config

title: Checkout page blank for users
sample_log: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'paymentMethods'
root_cause: Stale CDN asset served old JavaScript bundle incompatible with new API response.
remediation: Add asset versioning and cache-busting validation

title: Recommendation service CPU saturation
sample_log: recommendation query processed 50000 candidates without limit
root_cause: A missing query limit caused recommendation computation to scan too many records.
remediation: Add guardrail for maximum candidate count

title: Duplicate billing charges
sample_log: processed payment retry without idempotency_key transaction_id=txn-58291
root_cause: Billing retry flow did not enforce idempotency keys during provider timeout retries.

title: File uploads failing
sample_log: object storage put failed: AccessDenied bucket=user-uploads
root_cause: Object storage IAM policy was changed and removed write permission for upload-service.

title: Kubernetes pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff
sample_log: failed to parse config: invalid YAML at line 17
root_cause: Invalid YAML syntax in ConfigMap caused application startup failure.
remediation: Add config linting in CI pipeline

title: Database slow queries impacting API
sample_log: slow query detected duration=12400ms table=orders filter=user_id
root_cause: Missing index on orders.user_id caused full table scans during high traffic.

title: Tracing data missing from dashboards
sample_log: exporter queue is full, dropping spans count=12000
root_cause: OpenTelemetry collector queue filled due to insufficient memory and exporter throttling.

title: Service discovery DNS failures
sample_log: lookup inventory-service.default.svc.cluster.local: no such host
root_cause: CoreDNS pods were overloaded and unable to resolve internal service names reliably.

title: External payment API TLS failure
sample_log: TLS handshake failed: certificate has expired
root_cause: Expired client certificate used for communication with external payment provider.
remediation: Add certificate expiry alert 30 days before expiration

title: Scheduled reconciliation job did not run
sample_log: cronjob reconciliation-cron has not scheduled a job in the last 24h
root_cause: Kubernetes CronJob was accidentally suspended during a maintenance change.
remediation: Add alert for suspended production CronJobs
